Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ('Listing Regulations'), we wish to inform you that Ms. Harshita Singhal had tendered her resignation from the position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) of Safecure Services Limited ('the Company').
